name: Godot Mod Loader mod
summary: A mod for Godot games that include the Godot Mod Loader (Brotato, Dome Keeper and others): manifest.json, mod_main.gd and a zip in the layout the loader expects.
description: The mods-unpacked/Author-ModName folder with a valid manifest.json and mod_main.gd, plus a script that builds the zip players drop into the game's mods folder. The folder name, the manifest and the zip's inner layout must all agree; this project makes them agree.

options.label: Mod name
options.patternHelp: at least 3 characters; letters, digits and _ only, no spaces (a Godot Mod Loader rule)
options.help: Second half of the mod's ID, Author-ModName. The ID is also the folder name and must never change once people use the mod.

options.label: Author
options.patternHelp: at least 3 characters; letters, digits and _ only, no spaces (a Godot Mod Loader rule)
options.help: The mod's namespace: first half of the mod's ID.

options.label: Version
options.patternHelp: three numbers without leading zeros, like 1.0.0

options.label: Description
options.default: One or two sentences about the mod.

options.label: Website
options.help: A link to the mod's page or repository. May stay empty.

options.label: Game folder
options.help: The folder with the game's exe. build-zip.bat copies the zip into its mods folder. Leave empty to copy it by hand.

options.label: Godot version of the game
options.help: GDScript differs between the two: mod_main.gd and the extension example are written for the one picked.

options.label: Mod Loader version
options.help: The Godot Mod Loader version the mod is written for (compatible_mod_loader_version).

options.label: Mod Loader version
options.help: The Godot Mod Loader version the mod is written for (compatible_mod_loader_version).

options.label: Game version
options.help: The game version the mod is made for (compatible_game_version). Mod Loader 7 refuses a mod made for an older major version than the game reports.

options.label: Script extension example
options.help: An extensions folder with a script that extends one of the game's scripts, and the line that installs it.

options.label: Game script to extend
options.patternHelp: a res:// path to a .gd file of the game
options.help: The res:// path of a script in the game. The loader logs an error if it does not exist.

next: Run build-zip.bat: it writes dist\<Author>-<ModName>-<version>.zip and, with a game folder set, copies it into the game's mods folder.
Start the game and look for the mod's "Ready!" line in the game's log (user://logs/modloader.log).
To work in the Godot editor, copy the mods-unpacked folder into the decompiled game project.
